description: Location awareness — map views, proximity search, directions, and live tracking.

screens_added.name: Map View
screens_added.purpose: Full map with pins for relevant entities

screens_added.name: Location Picker
screens_added.purpose: User selects or confirms their location

screens_added.name: Nearby Results
screens_added.purpose: List of entities sorted by proximity

screens_added.name: Live Tracking
screens_added.purpose: Real-time position of driver, delivery, or provider

flows_added: Enable location → map loads at current position → browse nearby pins → tap pin → detail
Search location → drop pin → confirm → use as address
Order placed → tracking screen opens → driver moves on map → arrival
interaction_patterns: Map pins cluster at low zoom — expand on zoom in
Current location button — always visible, tapping re-centres map
Detail sheet slides up from bottom — map stays visible behind
Live tracking dot pulses — indicates real-time movement
ETA chip always visible on tracking screen
Location permission prompt — explain why before requesting

error_flows.ui: Map loads centred on default city or last known location. Banner: 'Enable location to see places near you'. CTA: direct link to device settings. Search still fully functional. Never block app usage.
Location dot shows with accuracy ring — larger ring = less accurate. Banner: 'Location accuracy is low'. Indoor location note if relevant. Never show false precision.

error_flows.trigger: Map tiles fail to load (offline or CDN failure)
error_flows.ui: Show cached tiles for last viewed area if available. Grey placeholder for uncached areas with grid lines. Message: 'Map tiles unavailable — check your connection'. Search and pins still functional.
Message: 'Could not calculate route'. Retry button. Fallback: 'Open in Maps' — opens device native maps app with same destination. Never strand user without navigation option.
Last known position shown with timestamp: 'Last updated 2 mins ago'. Pulsing amber dot instead of live green. Auto-reconnects in background. Never show stale position as live.

error_flows.trigger: Place data not found or outdated
error_flows.ui: Show: 'Limited information available for this place'. Display what is known. 'Suggest an edit' CTA. Never show completely blank place detail screen.

edge_cases.case: User is at exact boundary of two regions/zones
edge_cases.ui: Assign to nearest centroid — never show both zones simultaneously. Do not ask user to choose. Log boundary case for data improvement.

edge_cases.case: User denies location then later grants it
edge_cases.ui: Map immediately re-centres on actual location when permission granted. No restart required. Smooth transition — fly-to animation to actual location.

edge_cases.case: Multiple pins stacked at same coordinates
edge_cases.ui: Show cluster circle with count. Tap to zoom in and separate. At max zoom: show stacked list sheet from bottom with all places at that location.

edge_cases.case: User location in a country with map data restrictions
edge_cases.ui: Show best available data without exposing restriction reason. Never show 'Content not available in your region' — show what is available.

edge_cases.case: Offline navigation — route calculated but data changes en route
edge_cases.ui: Offline route followed as downloaded. If recalculation needed and no connection: show 'Route may be outdated' banner. Continue with last known route. Do not stop navigation.

edge_cases.case: Very dense urban area — hundreds of pins visible
edge_cases.ui: Cluster aggressively at low zoom. Max 20 individual pins visible at any zoom level. Performance: never render more than 50 DOM pin elements — use canvas for overflow.
